purpose: Bind the provider-neutral founder-content n8n route to FCR-owned exact one-shot approval readback while preserving provider preflight, replay resistance, and provider-native outcome proof as separate authority layers.

claims: src/http/routes/n8nConveyor.ts must require authenticated founder execution through the FCR-owned authoritative n8n approval adapter, reject caller-supplied approval objects, and must not treat route acceptance as publication truth.

src/lib/n8nFounderContentAuthorityAdapter.ts must preflight n8n transport, provider allowlisting, and provider/platform compatibility before consuming one-shot authority, then atomically claim the exact FCR-stored approval before any provider dispatch and fail closed on missing or mismatched authority.
src/lib/authoritativeN8nFounderContentPublisher.ts must remain a compatibility export for the FCR-owned n8n authority adapter and cannot create an alternate approval or publication authority path.

src/http/routes/__tests__/n8nConveyor.founderContent.integration.test.ts must prove the founder-authenticated route delegates through authoritative approval readback, remains non-published without provider readback, and rejects caller-supplied approval objects.

src/lib/__tests__/authoritativeN8nFounderContentPublisher.test.ts must prove stored-approval injection, forged-approval rejection, preflight-before-consumption behavior, provider/platform mismatch rejection, and atomic claim failure before provider dispatch.
README.md must describe the source-level n8n approval adapter without claiming deployed n8n, Buffer credentials, provider mutation, readback, or live publication outcome.

docs/PUBLIC_COMMUNICATION_TRUTH_CONTRACT.md must require the same FCR-owned one-shot approval membrane for provider-neutral n8n writes, must preflight configuration before consumption, and must keep provider-native readback as terminal publication evidence.
